hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-schaumburg.title: Schaumburg and Steinhude Easy Scenic
hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-schaumburg.slogan: A 108 km loop out of Hannover north-west edge
hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-schaumburg.story: Shorter, civilised and good when the weather window is thin. 108 km round from Garbsen-Mitte - plan on about 2 h 15 of riding. On the way it passes Wunstorf, Steinhude water stop and Stadthagen. Rehburg forest road is the high point. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

bhutan-east-west-highway-paro-trongsa.title: Bhutan East-West Highway: Paro to Trongsa
bhutan-east-west-highway-paro-trongsa.slogan: Paro to Trongsa, over 3100 m · one way, about 282 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Paro
waypoints.advice: Paro is where the day begins. Next is Thimphu.

waypoints.advice: Thimphu comes up 71 km in. Next is Dochula Pass.

waypoints.name: Dochula Pass
waypoints.advice: 141 km in you reach Dochula Pass. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Punakha, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Paro → Thimphu is 28 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Thimphu → Dochula Pass climbs about 3100 m in 14 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Dochula Pass → Punakha drops about 3100 m over 22 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Punakha → Trongsa is 78 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Bhutan East-West Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 56 km this is Bhutan East-West Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Bhutan East-West Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3100 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

bhutan-east-west-highway-paro-trongsa.story: A one-way ride of 282 km, Paro to Trongsa - roughly 3 h 52 in the saddle. It goes by way of Thimphu, Dochula Pass and Punakha. The highest point is about 4,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
